In the heart of a bustling city, tucked away in a quiet alley off Phạm Huy Thông street in Gò Vấp district, lies a unique sanctuary dedicated to the preservation of ethnic instruments. This hidden gem is the home of Mr. Đức Dậu, a passionate collector and performer of traditional Vietnamese musical instruments who has spent over three decades amassing a vast collection of more than 2,000 artifacts.

Across from his house was a theater where he was exposed to the vibrant world of music and arts, which sparked his lifelong passion for traditional sounds. Despite initial resistance from his family, who wanted him to pursue medicine, Mr. Dậu’s destiny was intertwined with music.
